title: AERO user token payload (C3, final)
description: Payload of an aero1 token. The signature covers the exact payload bytes (see api/token.md); verifiers must verify before parsing.

iss.description: Issuer: sub (commercial platform) or edge (node-local console).

kid.description: Signing key id; selects the public key on the verifier.

uid.description: Opaque user id. MUST NOT contain email, phone or name (PII).

jti.description: Unique token id, used by the revocation list (C4).

tier.description: Plan name defined by sub; informational only. Edge never interprets it and enforces only the explicit limit fields below.

classes.description: Traffic classes this token may open (ADR-0003).

max_devices.description: Hard limit of concurrent QUIC connections per uid on one node (atomic count). Cross-node totals are enforced by sub via revocation.

quota_bytes.description: Traffic quota for the billing period, enforced per node; 0 or absent = unlimited. Cross-node totals are enforced by sub via revocation (C4/C6).

exp.description: Expires at, Unix seconds. exp - iat <= 604800 (7 days).

bw_bps.description: Per-uid bandwidth limit in bytes per second on one node; 0 or absent = unlimited.
